spotlight.title: Meaning Holism
spotlight.summary: [Revised entry by Henry Jackman on October 28, 2026. Changes to: Main text, Bibliography] The term "meaning holism" is generally applied to views that treat the meanings of all of the words in a language as interdependent. Holism draws much of its appeal from the way in which the usage of all our words seems interconnected, and runs into many problems…
